shared_elements: low-relief carving on a rectangular slab
animals arranged in a horizontal register/row
figures oriented in a common direction
justification: Both surfaces carry shallow relief carving with quadrupeds in profile arranged along a horizontal band, which is a very generic correspondence. A depicts a narrative hunt scene with human archers, a spoked chariot wheel, harnessed horses and collapsing prey rendered with anatomical detail, while B shows abstracted, repetitive rows of schematic animal and arch-like forms with no human figures, objects or narrative action.
